claims.blind_spot: Deliberate below-threshold hazard label and unsupported sensor expose fixture limitations; review is not detection.
claims.cost_basis: Illustrative Gemini fixture prices; Jev fixtures use pinned list price, not actual usage.
claims.environmental: Potential reduction of unnecessary cloud work. No energy or carbon measurements.
claims.fairness: Same frames, local policy, event trigger, two-escalation cap and Gemini role schemas. Rules has no model work.
claims.faults: Provider faults injected at the supervisory boundary; rules has no provider to fail. Unknown usage stays unknown.
